crossRefs.note: That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given…
“I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn…
Won’t the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision…

parallels.note: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for…
But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom, on the day of judgment, than for you.”

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
translations.bsb: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
